run_sequential_jobs_from_json: run sequential training jobs by generating bash commands from a JSON parameter sweep file
create_bash_experiment_plan: create a bash script that runs multiple training experiments with different hyperparameter combinations
build_hyperparameter_sweep: build a cartesian product of hyperparameters from a JSON config to generate training commands
write_training_commands: write training commands to a file with GPU device settings and checkpoint directories
generate_experiment_artifacts: generate experiment directories and command files for wandb logging and model checkpointing
